Name: Enc_Bandits
Summary: Men waiting where the road narrows. They want the baggage, and they will take it without a fight if that is offered.

Name: Enc_BanditsViaEgnatia
Summary: The Via Egnatia runs a long way between garrisons, and the hill country either side of it is not policed at all.

Name: Enc_SicariiOnTheRoad
Summary: Two men fall into step alongside, friendly enough, and neither of them has his right hand in view. They kill collaborators in crowds and walk away in the noise.

Name: Enc_TempleGuardPatrol
Summary: Temple police on the Jerusalem road, working from a list of names. Yours is on it.

Name: Enc_RomanCheckpoint
Summary: An auxiliary post stopping everyone on the road and taking longer over you than over the man in front.

Name: Enc_Storm
Summary: The wind gets behind the ship and stays there. The crew stop answering questions and start throwing cargo over the side.

Name: Enc_DrivenOffCourse
Summary: Days of running before weather that will not let the ship point where the master wants it. Nobody aboard is sure any longer where the coast is.

Name: Enc_Shipwreck
Summary: Ground under the keel where there should be none, and the stern beginning to break up in the surf.

Name: Enc_Pirates
Summary: A light hull closing from windward with too many men on deck for a trader. Rare in these waters since Pompey cleared them, which is why nobody is ready for it.

Name: Enc_FellowBeliever
Summary: Someone travelling the same way who turns out to know the same people, and wants to know what has been happening where you have come from.

Name: Enc_MerchantCaravan
Summary: A trader with guards, going your way and content to have another body on the road. Safer, slower, and full of talk.

Name: Enc_ImperialCourier
Summary: A rider of the imperial post changing horses at the station, carrying official news faster than anyone else on this road can.

Name: Enc_SynagogueHospitality
Summary: A synagogue in the next town that takes in travellers, asks where you are from, and will want to hear you before it decides about you.
